onset.Description: start_ind_re_valid_alldataset[source_index] / 125 Hz (seconds from the first frame of ecog_alldataset)

trial_type.Description: always 'word': one spoken-word trial of the authors' release

source_index.Description: 0-based index of the trial in label_alldataset / start_ind_re_valid_alldataset / end_ind_re_valid_alldataset of HB02.h5. Rows here are sorted by onset; the deposit's own order is not chronological.

start_frame.Description: start_ind_re_valid_alldataset value (0-based frame of ecog_alldataset; the authors' prepare_data notebook calls these the trial onset indices)

end_frame.Description: end_ind_re_valid_alldataset value (0-based frame; the notebook calls these the trial offset indices)
